lines: ₹5,055 crore from India. ₹3,666 crore for the whole group. So where did the rest go?
Up 18% from ₹3,102 crore a year ago. On sales of ₹65,436 crore, that's about ₹5.60 kept as profit from every ₹100.
Q2 FY27, consolidated, profit to shareholders. Source: company results via Business Standard
India sales: ₹42,653 crore, up 22.6%. That's about 65% of the group's sales, at a 25% operating margin.
Q2 FY27 vs Q2 FY26. Source: Business Standard
Everything outside the India business, taken together, pulled the group's profit about ₹1,389 crore below what India made on its own.

UK operating loss in one quarter
UK sales fell to ₹5,275 crore and deliveries dropped 22% from the last quarter. The Netherlands still made money, but less: ₹790 crore vs ₹916 crore.
Operating = EBITDA, before interest and tax. Source: Business Standard
About $12 billion in cash for the Anglo-Dutch steelmaker. Its UK and Dutch plants are the European business today.
The UK loss was smaller than a year ago (₹765 cr) but bigger than last quarter (₹341 cr). Group net debt: ₹91,423 crore.
CEO T V Narendran called India "the cornerstone of our performance".
Real story: India carries the group.
